Under Eby’s NDP, seniors face a broken healthcare system, with over 40%
of low-income seniors unable to afford necessary medical treatments or
even basic dental care.
Many seniors go years without access to affordable vaccines or hearing aids
because the NDP has consistently failed to prioritize their health.
